phase_1.title: Phase 1 · T-34-85 Firing Solenoid & Primer Ignition
phase_1.description: Closing the crew firing circuit energizes the breech firing pin, igniting the primary propellant charge inside the sealed 85×629mmR ZiS-S-53 (BR-365A APHEBC) chamber.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 295 MPa Chamber Deflagration
phase_2.description: Rapid propellant burn drives chamber pressure to 295 MPa against the heavy locked breechblock while accelerating the heavy projectile.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 4645 mm Ordnance Acceleration
phase_3.description: Expanding gases accelerate the 85×629mmR ZiS-S-53 (BR-365A APHEBC) round along the 4645 mm barrel up to 792 m/s (2,890,000 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Bore Clearance & Muzzle Blast
phase_4.description: The projectile clears the muzzle crown cleanly for engagements out to 1500 m while bore gases evacuate safely away from the crew.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Hydropneumatic Recoil Absorption
phase_5.description: Recoil cylinders absorb 9800 N-s of impulse smoothly across the cradle while transferring residual load into the chassis.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Breech Opening & Stub Extraction
phase_6.description: During battery runout, hydropneumatic recoil cylinders damp main-gun impulse and semi-automatically open the sliding breech, ejecting the spent base stub cleanly into the deflector bin.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Munition Ramming & Battery Lock
phase_7.description: The next 85×629mmR ZiS-S-53 (BR-365A APHEBC) round seats into the chamber and locks the breechblock back into firing readiness.

zh.headline: 苏联 T-34-85（1944 型）1:1 中型坦克：1944 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: T-34-85 将 45mm 60° 倾角避弹车体、V-2-34 全铝 V12 柴油机与宽履带克里斯蒂螺旋弹簧悬挂融为一体，并换装 1,600 mm 宽座圈三人铸造炮塔与 85mm ZiS-S-53 火炮，一举扭转了东线装甲力量天平。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：T-34-85 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1944 年问世的 苏联 T-34-85（1944 型）1:1 中型坦克 由苏联第 183 厂 / 第 112 厂（红色索尔莫沃）主导研制，定位为经典的二战传奇中型坦克（1:1 真实尺度）。1944 至 1946 年间苏联及战后盟国累计生产逾 48,000 辆 T-34-85，其倾斜装甲与柴油动力布局直接奠定了此后半个世纪主战坦克的设计蓝图。
T-34-85 将 45mm 60° 倾角避弹车体、V-2-34 全铝 V12 柴油机与宽履带克里斯蒂螺旋弹簧悬挂融为一体，并换装 1,600 mm 宽座圈三人铸造炮塔与 85mm ZiS-S-53 火炮，一举扭转了东线装甲力量天平。 整件装备总长 8,100 mm（含炮管向前 · 车体 6,100 mm）、空重 32200 kg，成为同期重装坦克领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1944 年，苏联第 183 厂 / 第 112 厂（红色索尔莫沃）推出了划时代的苏联 T-34-85（1944 型）1:1 中型坦克。1944 至 1946 年间苏联及战后盟国累计生产逾 48,000 辆 T-34-85，其倾斜装甲与柴油动力布局直接奠定了此后半个世纪主战坦克的设计蓝图。 它的核心设计聚焦于45mm 60° 大倾角焊接首上装甲等效 90mm 且极易诱发穿甲弹跳弹，奠定了其在重装坦克发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主战坦克复合装甲炮塔壳体

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 苏联 T-34-85（1944 型）1:1 中型坦克 的机械灵魂在于其「半自动立楔炮闩 · 三人铸造大炮塔人工定装弹装填」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，主炮发射后液压驻退复进机吸收巨额炮膛后坐并自动开闩抛壳待装，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用战时 4BO 橄榄绿轧制焊接与铸造装甲钢精加工而成。1,600 mm 加大座圈三人铸造炮塔彻底解放车长指挥与瞄准分工，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。苏联 T-34-85（1944 型）1:1 中型坦克 采用半自动立楔炮闩 · 三人铸造大炮塔人工定装弹装填。在每个击发周期中，主炮发射后液压驻退复进机吸收巨额炮膛后坐并自动开闩抛壳待装。借助战时 4BO 橄榄绿轧制焊接与铸造装甲钢工艺与高强度配合，实现了1,600 mm 加大座圈三人铸造炮塔彻底解放车长指挥与瞄准分工。
acts.focusPartLabel: 重型立楔/螺式主炮炮闩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 85×629mmR ZiS-S-53 (BR-365A APHEBC) 弹药规格与 4,645 mm（85mm L/54.6 24 条右旋线膛炮 · 1:25 倍径），最高工作膛压约 295 MPa，可赋予弹头 792 m/s 的出膛初速与 2,890,000 J 动能，有效作用距离达 1500 米。
内膛技术特点方面，85mm ZiS-S-53 24 条深膛线炮管，发射 BR-365A 被帽风帽穿甲榴弹有效击穿虎式装甲。同时，V-2-34 全铝合金 500 马力 V12 柴油机大幅降低燃油起火风险，令其在 6–8 发/分（三人炮塔人工装填） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 4645 毫米身管与 85×629mmR ZiS-S-53 (BR-365A APHEBC) 口径，苏联 T-34-85（1944 型）1:1 中型坦克 实现了每秒 792 米的初速与 1500 米有效射程。85mm ZiS-S-53 24 条深膛线炮管，发射 BR-365A 被帽风帽穿甲榴弹有效击穿虎式装甲，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 56 发容量的尾舱隔爆泄压主炮弹药架与 2040 mm 膛轴设计，苏联 T-34-85（1944 型）1:1 中型坦克 将单发后坐冲量控制在 9800 N·s 水平。500 mm 宽履带配五对克里斯蒂大负重轮驰骋东线泥泞与雪原。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-97）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 56 发容量的尾舱隔爆泄压主炮弹药架与出色的整体工效，500 mm 宽履带配五对克里斯蒂大负重轮驰骋东线泥泞与雪原。欢迎在 BAY-97 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 苏联 T-34-85（1944 型）1:1 中型坦克 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the T-34-85
paragraphs: Introduced in 1944 by Factory No. 183 / Krasnoye Sormovo No. 112 in Soviet Union, the Soviet T-34-85 (Model 1944) Medium Tank emerged as a defining WWII Legendary Medium Tank (1:1 Scale). Over 48,000 T-34-85 tanks were built from 1944 onward; its fusion of sharply sloped armor, wide-track mobility, and diesel propulsion became the blueprint for postwar tank design.

Combining a 60-degree sloped 45 mm glacis, the all-aluminum V-2-34 V12 diesel, and wide-track Christie coil suspension with a widened 1,600 mm three-man cast turret and 85mm ZiS-S-53 gun, the T-34-85 defined balanced medium-tank engineering. Measuring 8,100 mm (gun forward · 6,100 mm hull) at an unloaded weight of 32200 kg, it reshaped expectations across the 1:1 Main Battle Tank class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1944, Factory No. 183 / Krasnoye Sormovo No. 112 of Soviet Union introduced the Soviet T-34-85 (Model 1944) Medium Tank. Over 48,000 T-34-85 tanks were built from 1944 onward; its fusion of sharply sloped armor, wide-track mobility, and diesel propulsion became the blueprint for postwar tank design. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — 60-degree sloped 45 mm welded glacis doubles effective LOS armor and induces ricochets — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Soviet T-34-85 (Model 1944) Medium Tank sits its Semi-Automatic Vertical Sliding-Wedge Breech · Three-Man Cast Turret Manual Load. Throughout every firing cycle, hydropneumatic recoil cylinders damp main-gun impulse and semi-automatically open the sliding breech, containing 295 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in wartime 4BO olive-green rolled and cast armor steel, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Expanded 1,600 mm three-man cast turret separates commander observation from gunnery, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Soviet T-34-85 (Model 1944) Medium Tank relies on Semi-Automatic Vertical Sliding-Wedge Breech · Three-Man Cast Turret Manual Load. During each cycle, hydropneumatic recoil cylinders damp main-gun impulse and semi-automatically open the sliding breech. Machined from wartime 4BO olive-green rolled and cast armor steel, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Expanded 1,600 mm three-man cast turret separates commander observation from gunnery.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 85×629mmR ZiS-S-53 (BR-365A APHEBC) with 4,645 mm (85mm L/54.6 24-Groove RH Rifled · 1:25 Calibers), the Soviet T-34-85 (Model 1944) Medium Tank develops 792 m/s muzzle velocity and 2,890,000 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 1500 meters.

Internally, 85mm ZiS-S-53 24-groove rifled gun firing BR-365A APHEBC rounds capable of defeating Tiger I armor. Combined with its 6–8 RPM (three-man turret load) tempo, All-aluminum 500 hp V-2-34 V12 diesel lowers fire risk and extends range, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 85×629mmR ZiS-S-53 (BR-365A APHEBC) through its 4645 millimeter bore, the Soviet T-34-85 (Model 1944) Medium Tank achieves 792 meters per second and 1500 meters of effective reach. 85mm ZiS-S-53 24-groove rifled gun firing BR-365A APHEBC rounds capable of defeating Tiger I armor.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 56-round bustle blow-off ammunition rack with a 2040 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 9800 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Wide 500 mm tracks and five large Christie road wheels conquer mud and deep snow.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-97), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
